one_line: Cheap because growth is slowing in TurboTax and Credit Karma and AI fears hit software; QuickBooks is strong, so the fall is partly deserved and partly overdone.

why_fell.reason: May 2026: TurboTax outlook cut and 17% job cuts, despite a beat
why_fell.evidence: Shares fell about 20% after Q3. TurboTax growth cut to about 7%; CEO said Intuit lost on price with filers earning under $50,000. About 3,000 jobs cut.
Full-year adjusted EPS guided to $22.88-$23.12 versus $27.30 expected. Intuit chose lower TurboTax revenue per customer to win share. Shares fell about 12% premarket.

why_fell.reason: November 2026: Credit Karma miss and lower full-year revenue guide
why_fell.evidence: Credit Karma grew 9%, below plan. Full-year sales guide cut to 8-9% growth. Management blamed high rates and faster shift to AI chatbots for finding credit offers. Size of the Nov 20 drop not confirmed.

why_fell.reason: Broad fear that AI disrupts software
why_fell.evidence: Investors worry AI assistants could erode TurboTax Live and other franchises; the stock traded near 14 times fiscal 2026 earnings guidance in May.

for_unfair.point: Q1 fiscal 2027 sales rose 12% to $4.35 billion. QuickBooks Online Accounting grew 19%. Full-year QuickBooks segment guided to 13-14% growth.
for_unfair.source: Intuit earnings coverage (Seeking Alpha via TradingView; TradingKey call summary)

for_unfair.point: Intuit sold Mailchimp, its weakest unit, to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion; guidance for operating income and EPS was kept.
The FTC order over 'free' TurboTax ads was thrown out by the Fifth Circuit in March 2026. IRS Direct File was shut for 2026, removing a free-filing rival.

for_fair.point: Credit Karma's cut looks tied to AI: it got under 1% of traffic from search yet was hit by chatbot discovery. Management cut its fiscal 2027 growth to 3-7%.
TurboTax is guided to 2-3% growth in fiscal 2027 and a decline in Q2. Q2 total sales growth is guided to only 6-7%, below the 8% red-flag line.
Guidance has been cut or missed three times in six months (May, August, November). Stifel said rebuilding the customer funnel takes time and expects lagging performance.

what_market_fears: That AI chatbots take over customer discovery and basic tax filing, so Credit Karma and TurboTax keep slowing and the guided second-half pickup does not arrive.
what_would_prove_it_wrong: Sales growth near 8-9% holding through the tax season, TurboTax adding customers after the price cuts, and QuickBooks staying above 13% growth.
next_date_to_watch: Q2 fiscal 2027 results, expected around late February 2027 (date not confirmed); then Q3 results in May 2027 after tax season.

flag.note: Q1 growth was 12%, but Q2 is guided at 6-7%, under 8%; a second weak quarter in Q3 would trip it. Analysts also asked about the implied second-half pickup.

not_found: Exact size of the Nov 20 drop; Nov 2026 analyst ratings and price targets (found only undated items); any 2027 Direct File plan; a source showing AI tax tools taking real TurboTax share. IRS Direct File shutdown was reported by Route Fifty, read as summary only. Q1 figures partly from third-party summaries, not the press release page.
